label: Ready

issues.title: README missing deployment notes
issues.impact: Operators still need to read source and workflow files to understand release steps.
issues.remediation: Add a short deployment section covering environment variables, migration order, and rollback expectations.

issues.title: Webhook handler has limited error-path coverage
issues.impact: A malformed or replayed webhook could fail in production without a clear regression signal.
issues.remediation: Add tests for invalid signatures, duplicate events, and downstream timeout handling.

issues.title: Dependabot not configured
issues.impact: Dependency update drift will grow quietly over time without automated pull requests.
issues.remediation: Create .github/dependabot.yml with a weekly npm update schedule.

issues.title: Two production dependencies are one major version behind
issues.impact: Upgrade cost tends to compound when package gaps are left alone for multiple release cycles.
issues.remediation: Review the changelogs and plan one controlled upgrade pass for the outdated packages.

issues.title: Public API JSDoc coverage is inconsistent
issues.impact: Onboarding takes longer when exported utilities need to be inferred from source.
issues.remediation: Add JSDoc to the remaining exported helpers in src/lib and src/server.

issues.title: No explicit Node version pin in .nvmrc
issues.impact: Contributors may run slightly different local toolchains from CI.
issues.remediation: Add .nvmrc or document the preferred runtime version alongside the existing engines field.

recommendations: Add Dependabot so dependency updates arrive as routine pull requests instead of occasional cleanup work.
Expand webhook error-path coverage before the next payment-related release.
Document deployment and rollback steps in the README to reduce handoff friction.

top_issues.title: Webhook handler has limited error-path coverage

top_issues.one_liner: Update drift is manageable now, but automation will keep it that way.

quick_wins.title: Document deployment flow
quick_wins.action: Add a deployment section to README.md.

risks.title: Webhook failures could be under-tested
risks.scenario: Operational incidents around duplicate or malformed payment events would rely too heavily on manual validation.

risks.title: Dependency updates rely on manual attention
risks.scenario: Important package updates may sit longer than intended without automated reminders.

summary: demo-org/commerce-starter scores 88/100 (B - Ready). The codebase is in strong shape overall, with the remaining work centered on release documentation, webhook resilience, and routine dependency automation.
